王野和赵爷爷又闲聊了一会儿才回房睡觉。一夜无话，王野早早的就起来了。正在院里打拳，王铁柱就出来了。蹲在在门口的台阶上拿出自己的经济烟也不抽，就在那里唉声叹气。

王野实在看不下去了，走到王铁柱跟前，从兜里拿出两盒中华说：“爹，咱父子不用这样吧？想要你就说呗。”

王铁柱夺过王野手里的香烟没好气的说：“知道老子想要，你还不主动点儿，你以为老子愿意呀。”王野撇了撇嘴也不说话了。

自己老子的面子还是要给的，要是把王铁柱的面子当了鞋垫子，那王野肯定能得到两个鞋底子。

王野偷偷的说：“爹，你最好把烟藏好，要是让我娘看见了，肯定给你没收了。”王铁柱赶紧四处张望，着把烟装进兜里。

没一会秦婉就叫人吃饭了，王野同样是抱着王笑笑边喂边吃。吃完饭王野对着秦婉说：“娘，今天晚上别做饭了，我去朋友那里弄点羊肉，今天咱们炖羊骨头吃。”

秦婉小心翼翼的问：“没问题吧？”

王野说：“放心吧，都是打到了野山羊，我主要是要羊骨架，要是有肉就要点儿。”

秦婉：“野山羊行，能多弄点儿就多弄点。”

王野欣然答应，这要不是怕吓到他们。王野能整头羊带回家，慢慢来吧，这不是已经有进步了吗。秦婉都能说出让他多弄点儿的话了。

王野又一次走着上班去了，到了工厂。杨麦香已经带着杨璎珞和杨琮在门房等着了。王野上前打过招呼后道：“赵爷爷，我师父呢？”

赵爷爷说：“已经去劳资科了。”

王野调笑道：“呦，我师父这次挺积极呀。”

王野给赵爷爷一个眼神赵爷爷立马心领神会说：“嗯，是挺积极了。”

王野意味深长的看向杨麦香。可人家一点都没不好意思，大大方方的也看着王野。这一下把王野看的不好意思了。

王野忽略了杨麦香可是在农村自己过了这么多年。就农村的老娘们儿开的玩笑可比这个过火多了，王野还是太含蓄了。

没一会儿吴志强就回到了门房，进门就说：“师父，杨家妹子，办好了，回村开个证明就能上班了。”

王野问道：“师父，给我杨姑姑分到哪里了？”

吴志强说：“分仓库了，前几天不是刚抓了一个吗，正好就有了空位。”

王野笑呵呵的说：“那还行，工作还是很轻松的，就是那个李主任没问题吧。”

王野这话可是有两重意思。一个是李主任会不会因为上次的事儿心存芥蒂。再一个王野可是知道这老小子可是个色鬼。

吴志强说：“李主任怎么了？”

赵爷爷直接说：“放心吧，就算是这次他没什么大问题，也得老实一段时间。再说了，咱也算是卖了他个人情。至于别的，他没那个胆子。”

王野心想：“要不说老狐……家有一老如有一宝呢，这老爷子一听就知道王野的担忧。”

接着赵爷爷继续说：“志强，你带着麦香去办证明。”

吴志强说：“师父，今天小野不用做饭了吧，他闲着干嘛？”

王野不要脸的说：“我不会骑车。”

Wang Ye and Grandpa Zhao chatted for a while before going back to the room to sleep.After a night of silence, Wang Ye got up early.While boxing in the courtyard, Wang Tiezhu came out.He squatted on the doorstep and took out his economical cigarette without smoking. He just sighed there.

Wang Ye couldn't stand it anymore, so he walked up to Wang Tiezhu, took out two boxes of Chinese food from his pocket and said, "Dad, we don't have to do this, right? If you want, just say it."

Wang Tiezhu took the cigarette from Wang Ye's hand and said angrily: "You know I want it, but if you don't take the initiative, you think I am willing." Wang Ye curled his lips and stopped talking.

I still have to give him my face. If Wang Tiezhu's face is used as a shoe mat, then Wang Ye will definitely get two shoe soles.

Wang Ye said secretly: "Dad, you'd better hide the cigarette. If my mother sees it, it will be confiscated by you." Wang Tiezhu quickly looked around and put the cigarette in his pocket.

After a while, Qin Wan asked people to eat, and Wang Ye also held Wang Xiaoxiao and fed her while eating.After dinner, Wang Ye said to Qin Wan: "Mom, don't cook tonight. I'm going to get some mutton from my friend's place. Let's stew the mutton bones today."

Qin Wan asked cautiously: "Is it okay?"

Wang Ye said: "Don't worry, we have shot wild goats. I mainly want the sheep skeleton. If there is meat, I will order it."

Qin Wan: "Wild goats, if you can get as much as you can, get as much as you can."

Wang Ye readily agreed, if not for fear of scaring them.Wang Ye can take the whole sheep home. Take your time. Isn't this already progress?Qin Wan could even say something to ask him to do more.

Wang Ye walked to work again and arrived at the factory.Yang Maixiang was already waiting at the concierge with Yang Yingluo and Yang Cong.Wang Ye stepped forward to say hello and said, "Grandpa Zhao, where is my master?"

Grandpa Zhao said: "I have already gone to the Labor and Employment Department."

Wang Ye joked: "Hey, my master is quite active this time."

Wang Ye gave Grandpa Zhao a look, and Grandpa Zhao immediately understood and said, "Well, that's quite positive."

Wang Ye looked at Yang Maixiang meaningfully.But he was not embarrassed at all and looked at Wang Ye openly.This made Wang Ye feel embarrassed.

Wang Ye ignored Yang Maixiang, but he had spent so many years in the countryside.The jokes made about old ladies in the countryside are much more exaggerated than this, but Wang Ye is still too reserved.

After a while, Wu Zhiqiang returned to the concierge. When he entered the door, he said: "Master, sister of the Yang family, it's done. Go back to the village and get a certificate before you can go to work."

Wang Ye asked: "Master, where was my Aunt Yang assigned?"

Wu Zhiqiang said: "We have divided the warehouses. Didn't we just grab one a few days ago? There just happened to be a vacancy."

Wang Ye said with a smile: "That's not bad, the work is still very easy, but Director Li is fine."

Wang Ye's words have two meanings.One is whether Director Li has any grudges because of what happened last time.Wang Ye knew that this old boy was a pervert.

Wu Zhiqiang said: "What's wrong with Director Li?"

Grandpa Zhao said directly: "Don't worry, even if he doesn't have any big problems this time, he still has to be honest for a while. Besides, we have sold him a favor. As for other things, he doesn't have the guts."

Wang Ye thought: "If you don't talk about the old fox... an old man in a family is like a treasure. This old man will know Wang Ye's worries as soon as he hears it."

Then Grandpa Zhao continued: "Zhiqiang, take Mai Xiang to get the certificate."

Wu Zhiqiang said: "Master, Xiaoye doesn't have to cook today. What is he doing with his spare time?"

Wang Ye said shamelessly: "I can't ride a bicycle."
